verdict.rationale: Firstbase's registered-agent page publishes a flat price of $299.00, billed annually per state, so the core flat annual price is clearly documented. The renewal price is only implied by the word "Annually"; the evidence never explicitly states renewal terms or that renewals stay at $299. Missing for 10: an explicit renewal-price statement (e.g., "renews at $299/yr"), confirmation that the first year is not a promotional rate, and independent corroboration of the price.

support.subject: As a founder, registered-agent service has a published flat annual price, with the renewal price stated up front

citations.quote: Registered Agent available in all 50 states
